entities.summary: Aurelian Pavelescu is a Romanian politician. He has been serving as the president of the Christian Democratic National Peasants' Party (PNȚCD) since 2011 onwards. Previously, he had also served as a member of the Chamber of Deputies from 2004 to 2008.
